title: Yummy Kenyan Beef Wrap
description: A winey and bouncy post-workout Kenyan dish featuring a baguette and leaf wrap steam, served in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the baguette into 1 inch thick rounds and toast until lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Add the garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Wrap each toasted baguette round in a collard green leaf and steam for 2-3 minutes.
Assemble the wraps by placing the beef mixture onto the steamed baguette rounds.
Serve the wraps in a Korean brass bowl.
